svg.title: ESP32-S31 dual-module board, RGMII wiring
svg.desc: Pin by pin: six RGMII lines per direction (TXD0-3, TX_CTL, TXC), twelve in all, between module A (U101) and module B (U201), series resistors, and the clock path with delay buffer and bypass. Design only, not built or measured.
svg.text: RGMII wiring, pin by pin: module A (U101) and module B (U201)
design only, not built or measured
pin = WROOM-3 module pin number, IO = GPIO
A drives B: five data lines and the clock
B drives A: five data lines and the clock
Default build: buffer and its 22R fitted, 0R bypass not fitted. Option 1: fit the 0R bypass, leave the buffer and its 22R off.
The series 22R sit next to the driver pin; the buffer sits next to the receiving module. All pins are on the first GMAC pad set (IO_MUX).
Only these lines connect the two modules, and GND through the common plane. No 3V3 or 5V crosses.
